authority.required_rule: GLM is token/API inference only; token is secret; no PTY/filesystem/EntityOS/EffectGate authority; provider switching must preserve the same UnifiedDB turn/session/generation

design.context: bounded canonical JSON only; unknown non-JSON objects fail closed
design.identity: caller-provided turn_id, causal_id and generation are returned unchanged; this component does not mint canonical lifecycle identity
design.error_redaction: HTTP failure preserves status/body length/body SHA-256 only; provider body and token are not emitted

isolated_supporting_execution.environment: isolated non-production OpenAI container; no real GLM token/network inference used
isolated_supporting_execution.git_blob_reconstruction: 2/2 exact Git blob IDs matched before execution

strongest_counterhypothesis: A safe standalone HTTP client can still violate ClayVerse if wired as a second chat/turn authority or if a response is accepted after entity generation changed while the network call was in flight. Promotion therefore requires integration through the existing UnifiedDB TurnLifecycle/provider-selection spine with pre/post generation checks, causal re-entry and stale-response rejection; this branch deliberately does not add that router yet.
promotion_gate: Do not merge as a complete provider path until current main is rejoined and tests prove provider switching within one canonical turn/generation, timeout/failure handling, stale GLM response rejection, token non-persistence, and no direct effect/PTY authority.
